tools.name: vidcrawl_scrape
tools.description: Deterministic Video-to-Markdown & Storyboard extractor (0 LLM tokens). Extracts metadata, chapters, deduplicated timestamped transcript, and visual storyboard sprite sheet URLs from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or X URLs.

tools.name: vidcrawl_frames
tools.description: Extract targeted high-resolution JPEG frames at specific timestamps (seconds) from a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reel, or X video without downloading the full video.

tools.name: vidcrawl_search
tools.description: Search videos by topic or keyword. Use source: "live" (1 credit) for live YouTube discovery or source: "index" (0 credits, up to 1,000/day) for instant search across indexed transcripts, [MM:SS] timestamps, and creator sponsor/affiliate links (supports domain filter). tools.name: vidcrawl_agent
tools.description: Autonomous progressive-disclosure video understanding agent. Reads spoken transcript + visual storyboard frames to extract on-screen OCR, visual hooks, scenes, and custom JSON schema fields with [MM:SS] citations.
